# Keel

> Keel is a calm, dense, dark-first design system for admin interfaces: tokens, React + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 + Radix components, Lucide icons, admin templates, a docs site, a Figma library and a Claude skill.

## Start here
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): how to build admin screens with Keel (rules, procedure, what to avoid)
- [README.md](README.md): install, structure, commands

## Reference
- [Tokens](skills/keel/references/tokens.md): colors (dark + light), type, spacing, radius, elevation, motion, z-index
- [Components](skills/keel/references/components.md): which component for which need, key props, traps
- [States](skills/keel/references/states.md): state matrix for every component and panel
- [Layout](skills/keel/references/layout.md): app shell, widths, grids, breakpoints
- [Patterns](skills/keel/references/patterns.md): list, detail sheet, form, settings, roles, audit log, overview, auth
- [Snippets](skills/keel/references/snippets.md): copy-ready code
- [QA](skills/keel/references/qa.md): screenshot pass at 320/768/1024/1440 in both themes
- [Figma](skills/keel/references/figma.md): the Figma library, variables and modes

## Source
- tokens/tokens.json: the single source of truth for tokens
- components/index.ts: every export; components/_ui (primitives), components/_common (app-level)
- templates/: real admin screens built only from Keel components
